rows.note: Power-law values depend on cutoff/model assumptions; see F26. Do not describe the output as a measured class prior or true hidden-fault count.

rows.claim: Kiryo et al. (NeurIPS 2017) derive a non-negative PU risk estimator that clips the estimated negative-risk term at zero under PU mixture assumptions and a specified/estimated class prior. rows.claim: Potential-field tilt-angle / tilt-derivative transforms use ratios of vertical and horizontal derivatives to reduce sensitivity to source amplitude and highlight edges in some settings. The stronger claim that they automatically equalize deep and shallow contacts or guarantee fault detection is not established by the cited papers or a hidden-label test here.
rows.how_verified: Reviewed the cited literature and code description; H20 holdout report is stored but un-reproduced and uses known-fault proxies.
rows.note: Treat the equalization language as a hypothesis, not a verified physical result.

rows.claim: Slip-/dilation-tendency and fault-tip wing-crack processes are geological mechanisms discussed in the cited literature. rows.how_verified: Compared the cited papers with the H20 feature description; no independent hidden-fault validation exists.
